title: Recipe and Locker
author: Casper Montrose
blurb: Beatrix Delacroix, the new kid at a school built over something old, stays under the radar: head down, grades up, locker shut. Then a group chat starts predicting things that haven't happened yet — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now he must decide who to be when the labels come off, and time is already running out.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
